Before sunrise, a richly detailed broad leaf dominates the foreground with several tiny dew beads. A delicate beaded spider web connects slender stems to the right. Big and Little Wonderer, small in the lower-left, lean close together to inspect the wet leaf. A dry stone path curves away behind them. Wide atmospheric dark predawn garden with silver highlights and one faint warm horizon. A compelling mystery, not a scientific answer diagram.
